newsitem.title: UK: European VGO quietens after earlier sharp losses.
newsitem.headline: European VGO quietens after earlier sharp losses.

text.p: The European vacuum gas oil market spent most of Friday dusting itself down, having suffered sharp drops on Thursday caused by diving IPE gas oil futures.
A 25 kt, option 50 kt low sulphur cargo that had been attracting bids of in the mid-$160s found the buyer withdrawing
and the market was seen to be below this level now. Supplies were seen to be fair with an additional cargo available at the end of the month.
Barge activity has been limited because of low water levels on the Rhine which has increased barge freights.
There was some talk of buying interest for high sulphur material from the U.S., but nothing was confirmed.
Some Med producers said they were keeping VGO in their own system because it was uneconomic to sell at current prices.
